# Stow — Luggage Storage Da Nang

> Safe, simple luggage storage in Da Nang, Vietnam. Hourly and daily plans
> for tourists, flat-rate weekly and monthly plans for expats and visa
> runners. CCTV monitored, open 7am–10pm every day at 55 Bà Bang Nhãn,
> Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng — 10 minutes from Da Nang Airport.

## Pricing
- Hourly: 15,000₫/hour (min 1 hour)
- Daily: 60,000₫/day (up to 24 hours)
- Flat weekly: 150,000₫ (up to 1 week)
- Flat monthly: 300,000₫ (up to 1 month)
- Flat long-stay: 500,000₫ (up to 3 months)
- Oversized item surcharge: +30,000₫ (hourly/daily) or +50,000₫ (flat plans)
